verification_note: 30-day filing window widely stated. UNRESOLVED CONFLICT: the waiting period after joining is stated as 30 days in LIC's claim procedure document and 45 days in SBI's version of the same document. Waiting-period logic is deliberately NOT encoded as a predicate here - do not assert a number you cannot source.
evidence_checklist_en: Inform the bank branch where the premium was debited, first
Death certificate issued by the registrar
Copy of the first two pages of the passbook
failure_consequence_en: The nominee must file the claim within 30 days.
required_documents_en: Death certificate issued by the registrar
Legal heir or succession certificate, if no nominee was recorded
